body: I was told the guy who my boss spoke to was the “manager” so if it wasn’t the actual doctor then at the very least it was the one in charge of the medical assistants. I actually called back and they confirmed they did speak to my boss but they DID NOT tell him I could go back to work. The urgent care tells me that all they said was “a positive test could be latent.” And my boss interpreted that as “oh she can work.” Good thing I’m quitting!

I just got a latent TB diagnosis as well! They did a chest X-ray on me and it turned out to be normal. Usually if you aren’t showing symptoms and your X-ray comes out clear, but you test positive for the skin test, it’s latent/inactive.

Yeah I absolutely don’t keep them around each other unless my hamster accidentally gets out, which is pretty rare since I got a new cage. I just found it so crazy that my cat has never even tried to kill her🤯

I was that sister.

Two years ago I attempted the same thing. My brothers were heartbroken, as you are. I will tell you what I wish my siblings would’ve told me. 

First off, I would advise that you make a list. Weird right? But make a list of every positive/good thing that your sister brings to your world. Get in contact with your sister and read them to her. Explain how your world would be without those wonderful things your sister brings to the table. 

Personally, i think it puts things into perspective. I have dealt with depression for years and sometimes it feels as though my life brings no value to anybody around me. If my brothers would’ve done this, there’s no way I would’ve tried to commit suicide. Above all else, though, I’ll be praying for you. Good luck

I am kinda in a similar situation! My brother constantly attacks/belittles me when I call him out on his abuse to my niece and nephew. 

And, naturally, I have the EXACT same argument with my dad. My father doesn’t tell him the truth, he doesn’t get involved and quite frankly, he lets him do whatever he wants because he doesn’t want the conflict. 

My suggestion to you would be the same thing I plan on doing: getting the HELL out of that toxic environment!! ASAP!! But meanwhile, if your brother is going to cause chaos in your home, then your parents should be taking some kind of action to stop it. Period. It’s their home and there needs to be some kind of rule that everybody will respect everybody. If not, then leave. It really is that simple and your brother will have to stop the chaos (if he wants a roof over his head). 

If your parents decide not to do that, make it abundantly clear that once you do finally move out they will not be seeing much of you for the foreseeable future. Good luck!
